rules: Use official and primary sources for factual grounding; secondary sources are contextual only.
Every future acquired document must link to source_id and syllabus topic IDs.
Edition and publication date must be retained for all annual reports and datasets.
Source recommendations are discovery hints; verify current URL, edition, licence and relevance before ingesting.

use: NCERT chapter catalogue for foundational reading
Exam notifications and official history/culture publications
PRS only for relevant legislation/policy context

Parliament/CAG for oversight and accountability
